2026-10-11 11:49:41.371860 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-11 11:49:41.371868 | controller |
2026-10-11 11:49:41.371875 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-11 11:49:41.371881 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-11 11:49:41.371892 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-11 11:49:41.371898 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-11 11:49:41.371904 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
